title: Finite evaluation of the transpose of an ordinary system morphism
statement: Let l be prime, E a finite extension of Q_l, f:X to Y a morphism of schemes, b a tower base, and g a Geometry for f [def-sp-tower-shriek-data]. For systems M on Y and N on X and h:g.pull(M) to N, evaluating the g.ordinaryAdjunction transpose of h at n and composing with g.ordinaryPushEvaluation at N equals the canonical constant-ring adjunction transpose of g.ordinaryPullEvaluation.inv at M followed by evaluation of h. This is an equality of finite module-sheaf morphisms, before localization.

source.place: clause (2), finite unit and tensor maps and their transposes

proof.text: Express transposition as the adjunction unit followed by the direct image of the map. The normalized system unit evaluates to the finite unit followed by pushforward of inverse pull-evaluation. Naturality of ordinaryPushEvaluation identifies the two composites. The private adjoint_section helper applies homEquiv_naturality_right directly and this equality for the identity map to identify its action on a section. No nonempty-chart or nonzero-module hypothesis is used.

proof_origin.place: Clause (2); complete Lean proof of the finite tensor and adjunction coordinate step.

lean.statement:
theorem tensorComparison_adjoint_evaluation {b : SpTowerShriek.Base l E}
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} (g : SpTowerShriek.Geometry l E b f)
    {M : Systems Y (Arings l E Y)} {N : Systems X (Arings l E X)}
    (h : g.pull.obj M ⟶ N) (n : ℕ) :
    (SpTowerShriek.ev l E Y n).map ((g.ordinaryAdjunction.homEquiv _ _) h) ≫
        (g.ordinaryPushEvaluation n).hom.app N =
      ((Scheme.proEtaleConstantRingAdjunction (SpTowerShriek.R l E n) f).homEquiv _ _)
        ((g.ordinaryPullEvaluation n).inv.app M ≫ (SpTowerShriek.ev l E X n).map h)
